- The modifications in `TestSubWorkflowActionExecutor.java` are related to the changes in the other two files as they validate the new behavior introduced by the changes. The tests ensure that the new logic for handling sub-workflow configurations works as intended, confirming that properties can be overridden correctly.

- The entry in `release-log.txt` summarizes the overall purpose of the changes across all files, indicating that the modifications collectively address the issue of overriding sub-workflow configuration properties defined in parent workflows.
